{{Short description|Official of the Kununokuni}}
{{nihongo|'''Kukochihiko'''|狗古智卑狗}} as described in the [[Wajinden]] was an official of the [[Kununokuni]] and a described as the real power behind the government there.

The original text of [[Wajinden]] reads.
{{Cquote|其南有狗奴國 男子爲王 其官有狗古智卑狗 不属女王
}}

== Various theories ==

* Since the [[Wamyō Ruijushō]] is written as "Kikuchi", it is thought that '''Kikuchi-jibei dog''' is "Kikuchihiko" (Japanese) and is associated with [[Kumamoto Prefecture]] [[Kikuchi District, Kumamoto|Kikuchi-gun]].<ref>請見{{in lang|ja}}[http://www.kaff.jp/page011.html 菊池家の祖先] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190131142656/http://www.kaff.jp/page011.html}}的內文。</ref>。<ref>[[白鳥庫吉]]「倭女王卑弥呼考」『白鳥庫吉全集』（岩波書店、1969年）など多数</ref><ref>『卑弥呼考』雑誌「藝文」明治43年（1910年）5,6,7月号所載</ref><ref>『新訂　魏志倭人伝・後漢書倭伝・宋書倭国伝・隋書倭国伝　中国正史日本伝(1)』 [[石原道博]]編訳　岩波文庫　P44-45、P79</ref>
* Since his name is written before [[Himikoko]] it is theorized he had the true power in [[Kununokuni]]
* Some think that the derogatory meaning is removed from the official name.<ref name="邪馬台国-2">『邪馬台国』　[[石原洋三郎]]　令和元年10月　第一印刷　P61-62</ref> The word "狗" is fierce, and is thought to be "{{Nihongo|commitment|建|Takeru|タケル}}," meaning a heroic and brave man. {{Nihongo|2=古智|3=Kochi}}" means "old wisdom," but the opposite of "{{Nihongo|new|古い|Furui}}" is "{{Nihongo|New|新しい|Atarashii}}," and it is thought to be originally "{{Nihongo|New wisdom|新しい知恵|Atarashii Chie}}. The word "{{Nihongo|2=卑狗}}" is "Hiko," which is thought to be "{{Nihongo|Prince|彦}}" or "{{Nihongo|High sun|日高}}" or "{{Nihongo|Sun child|日子}}".<ref name="邪馬台国-2" />

== In popular culture ==
Kukochihiko is a character in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. In it he is depicted as a villain who overthrew [[Himikoko]] and conquered [[Kununokuni]], and attempted to conquer [[Yamatai]].
